I have created the refined **DESKTOP design reference for AISLEY (`info.aisley.app`)**, titled **"AISLEY Landing — existing screen refinement"**.

### Design Highlights & Fidelity Implementation:
- **Strict Brand & Color System:** Applied exact hex tokens: Canvas `#F7F5F7`, Surface `#FFFFFF`, Ink `#231429`, Muted `#594C5E`, Primary purple `#4C1268`, Hover `#3D0E54`, Tint `#F1EAF4`, Border `#E5DCE7`. Logistics actions and callouts strictly utilize `#2563EB` and `#EFF6FF`.
- **Layout & Typographic Hierarchy:** Formatted for a 1240px maximum width container with 32px desktop gutters. Applied Geist font weights (600–700 headings, 400–500 body), headline scale at ~56px with balanced 2–3 line wrapping, body text at 16px/1.6, and captions ≥14px.
- **Calm Editorial Structure (No Repetitive Chrome):** Replaced cluttered container cards with clean, purposeful grouping, subtle borders, 8px corner radii, and a strict 4px spacing rhythm.
- **Connected Marketplace & Workspace Media Alignment:**
  - **Hero (7:5 split):** Exact H1 and lead copy, prominent filled "Start shopping" action, inline Seller/Logistics portal links, early access notice, and right authentic storefront preview area.
  - **Buyers Section:** Balanced copy, 4 calm capability items, and the uncropped 1280×850 order milestone view.
  - **Sellers Section:** Reversed media/copy layout, Admin approval badge, merchant workflow bullets, and uncropped 779×437 workspace view with "Open seller portal".
  - **Logistics Section:** Distinct Logistics Blue (#2563EB) accents, exact qualifications callout (clarifying no courier web UI), and uncropped 780×437 hub console view with "Open logistics portal".
- **Workflow & Distribution:**
  - **From shop to doorstep:** 4-step sequential cycle (Browse & Order, Seller Prepares, Logistics Coordinates, Courier Delivers) with explicit channel names.
  - **Mobile Releases:** Buyer and Rider GitHub release columns with exact repository links and package inspection notices (no deceptive app store badges).
  - **Accessible FAQ Disclosures:** Five native HTML `<details>` elements covering early access, operational coverage, Admin approvals, mobile releases, and milestone tracking without GPS promises.
  - **Workspace Switcher & Footer:** Role-based access selector and clean footer directory preserving all legal and early-access designations.
- **Authentic Local Screenshot Affordances:** Included explicit uncropped ratios (`1280×850`, `779×437`, `780×437`), local asset references (`/screens/buyer.webp`, `/screens/seller.webp`, `/screens/logistics.webp`), and "Enlarge preview" modal affordances. Accessible controls meet ≥44×44px hit targets and reduced-motion static styling.
